verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance/GRC SaaS platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Vanta can be self-hosted. The material points the other way: Vanta hosts its own regional instances, MCP servers and a FedRAMP gov endpoint. Private integrations for on-premise systems (vanta-docs-52) only feed data into the hosted product, so they do not count as self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
